summary: Bind hw with isAdmissibleComb_reducedVacuum: the resulting coefficients Ψ are admissible, jointly invariant by hi, and satisfy chain_at_N because each reduced vacuum is fixed by the projections (projOnFinPart_pairTranslates).

steps.claim: Let T be the regrouping map from the tensor chain of pairs to the tensor chain of single factors.

Substituting into hw the combinations of isAdmissibleComb_reducedVacuum (bind) gives coefficients Ψ on admissibleTranslations(q·N), integral away from q, of size ≤ exp(x^60) if Q = ∅ (the size bound by the comparisons of the data); s is this admissibility.
steps.lean:
hw.bind _ _ D.isAdmissibleComb_reducedVacuum
    (hB := by simpa using fun _ ↦ Real.le_exp_of_log_le D.le_of_hasLogBound).imp fun Ψ s ↦

steps.claim: Joint invariance: for b ∈ ∏ K_j with b_m = 1 (m = 2(ϱ + 1)), the joint action on ⊗_j translateDatum(x, j) is T of twoKernelAction(b) on the paired tensors, and w is fixed by hi; so ∑ Ψ(x)·β(T(…)) is invariant.
steps.lean:
⟨⟨s.1, @id (_ = 2 * (_ + 1)) D.m_eq_two_mul_varrho_add_two ▸ fun b h β ↦ by simpa [s,
    twoKernelAction, ← ((lift_pure ..).trans (liftInPairs_pure ..) : T _ = TensorChain.pure ..)]
    using (congr(β (T $(hi b (h _ .refl))))), fun φ ↦ by

steps.claim: chain_at_N and the identity: w equals its image under ⊗_i (τ_N ∘ (P ⊗ P)), because every reduced vacuum is (projOnFinPart_pairTranslates); hence the paired chain of w is the combination of paired chains with data pairTranslates(projections); and the paired chain of w is chainComb(ϑ, Ψ, translateDatum, m) by linearity (the lift of a pure tensor is the chain).
steps.lean:
simpa [s] using! congrArg (TensorChain.lift (TensorChain.liftInPairs (D.liftKernel ϑ · |>.lift)) φ
    _) (hw.elim fun r e ↦ by simp +contextual [e, reducedVacuum, D.projOnFinPart_pairTranslates ϑ,
    e.1.1, ← pairTranslates.eq_1] : w = TensorChain.map (fun i ↦ translateSum .. ∘ₗ
    TensorProduct.map (projOnFinPart ..) (projOnFinPart ..)) _ w)⟩, by simp [s, chain]⟩
